dialogues.speaker: Lisa
dialogues.text: It's getting harder to make small talk these days. Even something as innocuous as "what fine weather we're having today" seems to fall completely flat...

response.speaker: Lisa
response.text: You can visit whenever you need to look something up.

response.speaker: Lisa
response.text: Naturally the library is free to access.

response.speaker: Lisa
response.text: Just don't forget to return books on time, or you'll make my job difficult.

choices.text: I'd like to know more about monsters.

response.speaker: Lisa
response.text: The monsters out in the wild? We've got many resources here in the library.

response.speaker: Lisa
response.text: Making good use of elemental advantages is the key to winning any battle.

response.speaker: Lisa
response.text: By the way, would you be interested in having a part-time job here?

response.speaker: Lisa
response.text: We need people to... need people for doing... We just need more people.

response.speaker: Lisa
response.text: You're leaving? Drop by again sometime when you're free.
